runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_07d63abb1fferGTyZ6JGDCaKer] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
The query returned **7180 blocks** for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC) from `mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node`. Each row shows the slot, timestamp, block root, and the **first-seen arrival time in ms** (fastest observation across all sentry nodes).

**Example rows:**

| Slot | Timestamp | Arrival (ms) |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| 14590527 | 2026-06-20 00:00:11 | 1,212 |
| 14590528 | 2026-06-20 00:00:23 | 1,164 |
| 14590529 | 2026-06-20 00:00:35 | 1,077 |
| ... | ... | ... |
| 14597998 | 2026-06-20 23:59:59 | 1,329 |

Arrival times ranged from **~200 ms** to **~3,700 ms** depending on the slot, with most blocks seen within 1,000–2,000 ms of slot start. The full result (7,180 rows) was saved to the output file.

[Turn 2 | session=ses_07d63abb1fferGTyZ6JGDCaKer] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart saved and uploaded:

**URL:** http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/fb861825e608/7cf92d36-db80-4ed1-aa90-40a0b3eaea05/arrival_distribution.png
**Host path:** /home/runner/.panda/data/storage/fb861825e608/7cf92d36-db80-4ed1-aa90-40a0b3eaea05/arrival_distribution.png

The histogram shows the distribution of ~7,180 block first-seen arrival times (in ms) across all mainnet slots on 20 June 2026, with most blocks arriving within 1,000–2,000 ms of the slot start.
